comparison.objective: Seat a glass condenser on a still-head cone and snap on a retaining clip; candidate adjusts, locks, and dynamically validates a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests fragile axial alignment, insertion, sustained one-hand support, and second-hand clip latching. Candidate tests hex-key seating, setscrew manipulation, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and feedback-driven repeated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires joint seating within 5 mm and 6 degrees, clip attachment, no glass drop or excessive tip, and arm withdrawal. Candidate requires two safe stops plus setting retention, but lacks numeric rebound, overload, drift, and locking-torque limits.
comparison.reason: Bimanual stabilization while fastening is shared, but the defining tested abilities differ: fragile joint insertion and snap-latching versus threaded adjustment, quantitative dynamic tuning, and post-lock retention.
